notes: Release date: kimi.ai official blog index 'Kimi K2.6 | 2026-04-20'; page asset timestamps 2026-04-20/21 agree. The page's summary DOM table was updated post-hoc to lead with a Kimi K3 column (K3 released 2026-07-16); the K2.6 column values remain the vendor's own and are machine-readable. The appendix 'Benchmark table' is machine-readable embedded JSON inside the page payload (full extraction 2026-09-01): all 33 printed appendix rows plus the prose text-only HLE subsets are enumerated as evidence rows. Two page-internal divergences (GPQA-Diamond and AIME 2026, appendix vs summary DOM table) are recorded as separate evidence rows without reconciliation. Global protocol from footnotes: K2.6/K2.5 thinking mode enabled; temperature=1.0, top-p=1.0, context 262,144 tokens; HLE max generation 98,304 (full set default; text-only subset 36.4 no-tools / 55.5 w-tools printed in prose); HLE-Full w/tools 262,144 max with 49,152 per step and retain-latest-round context management; coding scores averaged over 10 independent runs (note: 10, not the 5 used in earlier Kimi releases); SWE series on in-house SWE-agent-derived harness with bash/createfile/insert/view/strreplace/submit tools; Terminal-Bench 2.0 on Terminus-2 with JSON parser in preserve-thinking mode; vision avg@3 with max-tokens 98,304; MMMU-Pro official protocol (images prepended); APEX-Agents 452 of 480 public tasks; DeepSearchQA competitor scores cited from Claude Opus 4.7 System Card; IMO-AnswerBench GPT-5.4/Opus 4.6 values cited from z.ai/blog/glm-5.1; HuggingFace blocked-style contamination guards not restated here. Summary-table columns: Kimi K3 | Kimi K2.6 | GPT-5.4 | Claude Opus 4.6 | Gemini 3.1 Pro | Model A | Model B (last two anonymized).
